primaryTextChecks.text: Israel lived in Heshbon and its towns, and in Aroer and its towns, and in all the cities that are along the side of the Arnon for three hundred years! Why didn’t you recover them within that time?

context.text: Now are you anything better than Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab? Did he ever strive against Israel, or did he ever fight against them?
Therefore I have not sinned against you, but you do me wrong to war against me. May the LORD the Judge be judge today between the children of Israel and the children of Ammon.”

geographicalEvidence.reasonJa: ヨルダン東岸のアルノン川沿いにあった古代の町とされる。複数のアロエル候補があり、士師記の町の現代比定は確定しない。

wikipediaRead.supportingParaphraseJa: 記事はアルノン川北岸にあった古代都市をアロエルとして扱い、アラ・イルの古跡を候補に挙げる（116–120行）。複数の同名候補との同一性は本文だけでは確定しない。
